offers_products.reason: Sells AutoCAD, Revit, Fusion, Maya and other design software, sold as subscriptions.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from software subscriptions; consulting and support are incidental to the software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are professional designers, engineers, builders and studios; individual hobbyist and student use is minor.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Architecture, engineering, construction, manufacturing and media firms buy AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor subscriptions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Software is only available as subscriptions (monthly, annual, multi-year), renewed repeatedly.

cyclical_demand.reason: Seat counts follow AEC and manufacturing hiring and project activity, so firms cut seats in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Subscriptions are modest, recurring payments per seat, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for software technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customer base is broad, with many small and mid-sized firms and individual professionals alongside large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Cloud and desktop software business needs little physical investment in plants or fleets.

notes: Large versus small customer mix is a judgment call; the website text doesn't state it.
